subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google documents Vertex AI as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source-repro is clear, but changing provider copy without a maintainer-chosen canonical label could conflict with Google’s official wording or accidentally imply a provider-id/config rename.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new Google wording with the still-stable `google-vertex` provider id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave existing copy until maintainers decide that OpenClaw should follow Google’s rename across provider surfaces.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter’s shorter wording even though the official docs checked here use `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform`.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new Google wording with the still-stable `google-vertex` provider id.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion specifically routed the labelling decision toward this UI/UX and docs ownership area, which is the unresolved part after source verification.
